describes: Each prompt's word budget: the most words `mise run check:prompts` lets it hold, in one table keyed by the prompt's path, with the reason for each figure in its row. A prompt is every skill and agent, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, the worktree briefing's template, `.beads/PRIME.md` and each workflow under `.claude/workflows/`; the header of `scripts/check-prompts.mjs` says what a word is.
whyThisFileExists: A budget rises only by an edit here, and `prReviewHighRiskPaths` names this file, so a person merges every raise and every change to the reason beside it (`docs/decisions.md` § D-27). The budgets are one table with one reader, keyed by the path of the prompt each governs, so a reader finds a prompt's budget by its path and a budget with no prompt is a path that names nothing. Before D-27 each was a key of `tools/policy.json` whose name the gate built from the path, with a `Means` sibling of its own; a row now carries its reason inside it, as `CLAUDE.md` § Three kinds of file, and never a fourth allows a table keyed by what it governs.
gatedBy: mise run check:policy holds this record's header, the table's `Means`, and no key another record also defines. mise run check:prompts holds `promptWordBudgets`: it refuses a prompt over its budget or with no row, a row that names no prompt it reads, a budget that is not a whole number of at least 1, and a row with no reason; mise run check:prompts:selftest exercises each refusal on a fixture. mise run pr-review:check refuses a policy whose `prReviewHighRiskPaths` does not cover this record.
whatItDoesNOTDo: It counts no prompt's words: `scripts/check-prompts.mjs` does, and its header says what a word is and which files are prompts. It does not say how a prompt is consolidated before a raise, which is `.claude/agents/continuous-prompt-improvement.md` § How a prompt is consolidated, or when a prompt must be, which is `.claude/skills/bead/SKILL.md` § 4. Implement, regenerate, gate.

D-16 lowered `CLAUDE.md`'s to its count after it was consolidated and took a rule. asdlc-openspec-as9 added the trace workflow's budget, and change-verify's fell after its first consolidation. asdlc-openspec-j09.11 added the test-builder's budget and raised change-build's and `build-change-task.js`'s by what consolidating each first did not free, and asdlc-openspec-j09.13 raised change-build's again the same day. promptWordBudgetsMeans: The most words each prompt may hold, by its repository-relative path: `words` is the budget and `means` says why it is that figure, when it was set and by what. A row lands with its prompt, set to the words the prompt holds then, and leaves with it. A raise edits `words` and says why in `means`, once the prompt has been consolidated first (`docs/decisions.md` § D-12), and a person merges it, since `prReviewHighRiskPaths` names this file. Decided 2026-09-26 (asdlc-openspec-2wv) as one key per prompt, and made one table keyed by path on 2026-10-02 (D-27, asdlc-openspec-umg3), so that the gate looks a budget up by the path it governs rather than by a name it builds from it.
